postReview.title: Hürzeler pide al Brighton "mantener la humildad" tras golear al Palace
postReview.description: Fabian Hürzeler ha recalcado que sus jugadores deben mantener la humildad después de que el Brighton goleara por 5-0 a su rival, el Crystal Palace, en la Premier League.

postReview.title: Hurzeler urges Brighton to 'stay humble' after emphatic win over Palace
postReview.description: Fabian Hurzeler has stressed his players need to remain "humble" after Brighton thrashed rivals Crystal Palace 5-0 in the Premier League.

postReview.title: Hürzeler invita il Brighton a «restare umile» dopo il netto successo sul Palace
postReview.description: Fabian Hürzeler ha ribadito che i suoi giocatori devono restare "umili" dopo il 5-0 con cui il Brighton ha travolto i rivali del Crystal Palace in Premier League.

postReview.title: Hurzeler pede ao Brighton que "mantenha os pés no chão" após goleada sobre o Palace

postReview.title: Hürzeler mahnt Brighton nach Kantersieg gegen Palace zu Demut
postReview.description: Fabian Hürzeler hat seine Spieler zur Demut gemahnt, nachdem Brighton den Rivalen Crystal Palace in der Premier League mit 5:0 abgefertigt hatte.
